subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- August 27, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - August 27, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS Community,

We hope this newsletter finds you well. As we continue to work towards making AcreetionOS the best Arch-based Linux distribution for those seeking a private and user-friendly experience, we wanted to take a moment to highlight some of the recent developments in our community.

Firstly, we'd like to acknowledge the release of Armbian 26.8, a significant update to the popular Arm-based Linux distribution. This release brings various improvements and bug fixes, and we're excited to see the community's response to it.

In terms of security updates, AlmaLinux and Debian have issued patches for several packages, including Firefox, Gstreamer, and the Linux kernel. We recommend keeping your systems up to date to ensure the best possible security posture.

On the AcreetionOS front, we've been busy with various commits and updates across our repositories. Notably, we've made improvements to our CI/CD pipelines, including the addition of ShellCheck linting in acreetionos-plasma. We're committed to ensuring the quality and reliability of our codebase.

We've also made some visual updates to our website, including the use of a new webp logo as the favicon on all pages. Additionally, we've updated the source links in our immutable repository to point to spivanatalie64/acreetionos-immutable.

As we continue to grow and develop as a community, we're grateful for the contributions of our members. If you're interested in getting involved, please don't hesitate to reach out to us on our Discord server or through our GitLab instance.

In other news, Darren has been busy working on Calamares customization and ISO builds, while Natalie has been focusing on various development tasks, including the creation of new wiki guides and newsletter content.

We'd like to take a moment to thank our community members for their continued support and engagement. Your enthusiasm and contributions are what drive us to keep pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AcreetionOS.

As we move forward, we're excited to share more updates and developments with you. Stay tuned for future newsletters and announcements, and thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva & Darren Clift
